No added assertion compares its output against the same supplied value to claim route parity; the missing assertion is an integration test that reaches independently computed bank and present-route updates.

findings.text: The diverted and limited same-iterate updates differ by 1.002510 and 0.871164 relative, so both fail the required 1e-6 route parity gate and the step cannot land as satisfying the section.

The added test calls only _assert_update_agreement on fixed arrays; removing compare_route from measure.py main or passing bank_update as both arguments leaves this test green while the actual route comparison no longer protects parity.
